description:
Make sure you wear your collar nicely. So you never lose your way again.” From the beginning, their arranged marriage was never meant to include love. Ah-hyeon hid her long-held feelings, but she never gave up. “I enjoyed how you tried to seduce me just to get pregnant.” All her efforts were shattered and mocked by Yoon Ki-ju. “We should get divorced.” “You’ll never escape me for the rest of your life.” Even her hard-won decision is denied, but Ah-hyeon decides to leave him. There was something she had to protect—no matter what. “Make sure you wear your collar nicely. So you never lose your way again.” But the man ultimately finds her, and this time he fastens an even stronger collar around her— as if he would never let her go.
Source: MU
